page.overview:
What is Blue Jay Way?

Blue Jay Way is a song by George Harrison of The Beatles. It was included on the Magical Mystery Tour album

George Harrison wrote this song in his rented home in LA. Some friends (Derek Taylor and his wife Joan) had promised they would be there, and when they didn't arrive, he wrote this song as he waited for them. It turned out that they were lost.
